findings.description: The KMS key does not set enable_key_rotation, so it defaults to false and the same cryptographic material is used indefinitely. This increases the blast radius of a compromised key and violates common key-management requirements for keys protecting log data.

No explicit key policy is attached, so AWS applies the default policy granting the account root full access, which allows any IAM principal in the account with sufficient IAM permissions to use or administer the key. For a key protecting log data this weakens least-privilege separation between key administrators and log consumers.
